all at the same time.

sources.theme: staleTime static overrides always refetch triggers
sources.text: Tiny example. Even with `"always"` on `refetchOnMount`, `refetchOnWindowFocus`, and `refetchOnReconnect`, the docs say those refetches still won't happen because `'static'` overrides them for those triggers.
sources.code:
useQuery({
  queryKey: ['config'],
  queryFn: fetchConfig,
  staleTime: 'static',
  refetchOnMount: 'always',
  refetchOnWindowFocus: 'always',
  refetchOnReconnect: 'always',
})
